assumptions: A later artifact copies predecessor material and records a link to it.
The copied material's earlier relations are recoverable, but the claimed succession lacks an independent valid basis and successor-side establishment.
scenario.proposed_claim: The chain of references makes the later artifact a successor inheriting the predecessor's Source and Authority.
expected_reading: A navigable chain establishes neither an unstated conversion nor missing relation support.
Succession has not been established; ancestry, reference, or derivation may be recorded only at their supported scope.
Source cannot transfer, and Authority requires its own sufficient basis; a one-sided link establishes no reciprocal relation.
forbidden_inferences: Reference chains carry constitutional effects transitively.
scenario.invalidity_scope: The missing relation basis and claimed inheritance, not a malformed path or rejection by the annotation-only schemas.
